records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales generated in the three months ended September 29, 2024 increased $224.8 million, or 5.2%, from net sales generated in the three months ended September 24, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the third quarter of 2024, the U.S. chicken market experienced firm volume demand, supported by growth in both the retail and foodservice distribution channels throughout the quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Export volume in shipments were lower than the five-year historical average for the first two months of the quarter, but were sufficient to prevent buildup of dark meat inventories in cold storage while sustaining price levels that were higher than prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated a consolidated operating margin of 8.9%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income increased by $302.0 million, or 146.3%, from income of $206.4 million generated in the three months ended September 24, 2023 to income of $508.4 million generated in the three months ended September 29, 2024.
